Prescriber review of amiodarone (and of concomitant warfarin interaction) is required.

interpretations.explanation: 2026-03-07 tracing. Regular P waves (0.20 mV, upright in II/aVF, negative in V1) precede every QRS at a constant PR of 186 ms; rate 81/min with mild phasic RR variation (sinus arrhythmia). QRS 82 ms with no bundle branch block; frontal axis +47 deg (normal). QT 325 ms, Bazett QTc 378 ms - normal. No prior ECG on file, so no comparison possible. Findings match the same-day note documenting sinus rhythm.

2025-07-15 tracing. Sinus rhythm/mild sinus tachycardia at 104/min, regular (RR 0.578 s); clear upright P in II (0.22 mV), biphasic in V1, PR 136 ms. QRS 98 ms, no bundle branch block; axis +38 deg (normal). QT 338 ms, Bazett QTc 444 ms - upper normal. Prior ECG (100698634, 2025-06-20) showed sinus tachycardia at 147/min with QTc ~445 ms; rhythm and QTc are essentially unchanged. Note this patient's earlier 2025-02-26 tracing showed an irregular narrow-complex tachycardia consistent with atrial fibrillation.

2024-05-21 tracing. Sinus tachycardia at ~108/min, regular; upright P in II (0.12 mV) with PR about 120 ms. QRS 90 ms, no bundle branch block; axis +37 deg (normal). Repolarisation is abnormal with a low-amplitude, very broad T wave merging towards the following P: QT approximately 395 ms, Bazett QTc about 530 ms - prolonged (measurement is somewhat uncertain because of T-P fusion at this rate). No prior ECG for comparison. The patient is not on a QT watch-list medication, but the prolonged QTc merits attention.

2026-06-10 19:36 tracing. Absent P waves with a flat, undulating TQ baseline and a grossly irregular ventricular response (RR 0.35-0.65 s) at a mean rate of ~139/min - atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response; PR not measurable. QRS 98 ms, no bundle branch block; axis +2 deg (normal). QT 276 ms, Bazett QTc 420 ms (mean RR). The prior ECG the same afternoon (107914094, 17:13) was also atrial fibrillation at ~139/min with QTc 445 ms, so there is no rhythm change between the two and no significant QTc change. Both tracings contradict the same-day note reporting 'normal sinus rhythm, rate 72' (see CONTRADICTION item).

2025-08-02 tracing. Sinus rhythm 69/min, regular (RR 0.87 s); low-amplitude P best seen in V1/aVF with PR 142 ms. QRS 82 ms, rS in V1 with dominant R in V6, no bundle branch block; frontal axis -25 deg (normal, leftward end of range). QT 397 ms, Bazett QTc 425 ms. Prior ECG (104232242, 2025-04-27) was sinus rhythm at 60/min with QTc 407 ms but a markedly different frontal axis (near -175 deg, suggesting limb-lead reversal on that tracing); rhythm, conduction and QTc are unchanged within thresholds.

2024-05-23 tracing. Sinus rhythm at 97/min, regular (RR 0.616 s); upright P in II (0.18 mV) and negative in V1, PR about 118 ms. QRS 76 ms, rS in V1 with tall R in V6, no bundle branch block; axis +4 deg (normal). QT 309 ms, Bazett QTc 393 ms - normal. Only ECG on file, so no prior comparison.

2025-12-25 tracing. Sinus rhythm 72/min, regular (RR 0.83 s); small upright P in II with PR 140 ms. QRS 84 ms, deep S in V1 and dominant R in V6, no bundle branch block; axis +21 deg (normal). QT 371 ms, Bazett QTc 407 ms - normal. Only ECG on file. This remains the patient's most recent tracing despite escitalopram being started on 2026-08-01 (see FOLLOW_UP item).

2024-11-15 tracing. No P waves and an irregularly irregular ventricular response (RR 0.69-1.16 s, RMSSD 288 ms) at a mean rate of ~61/min - atrial fibrillation with a controlled/slow ventricular response; PR not measurable. QRS 92 ms, no bundle branch block; axis +26 deg (normal). QT 441 ms, Bazett QTc 446 ms (mean RR). The prior ECG three days earlier (107873952, 2024-11-12) showed sinus rhythm at 69/min with clear P waves and PR 170 ms, so atrial fibrillation is new on this tracing. QTc change (396 to 446 ms) is below the 60 ms threshold.

2025-03-09 tracing. Sinus rhythm/sinus bradycardia at 58/min; upright P in II (0.19 mV) with PR about 114 ms. QRS 86 ms with an rS in V1 and tall R in V6, no bundle branch block; axis +62 deg (normal). QT 421 ms, Bazett QTc 415 ms - normal. Prior ECG the day before (106045460, 2025-03-08): sinus rhythm 62/min, PR ~110 ms, QRS 86 ms, QTc 450 ms; rhythm and conduction unchanged and the 35 ms QTc difference is not significant.

2025-08-23 tracing. Sinus rhythm 83/min, very regular (RR 0.72 s); upright P in II with PR about 148 ms. QRS 72 ms, no bundle branch block; axis +54 deg (normal). QT 349 ms, Bazett QTc 412 ms - normal. Only ECG on file, so no prior comparison.

2020-06-19 tracing. Sinus rhythm 77/min, regular (RR 0.785 s); prominent upright P in II (0.26 mV) with PR 154 ms. QRS 72 ms, no bundle branch block; axis +65 deg (normal). QT 395 ms, Bazett QTc 447 ms. Prior ECG (109048192, 2020-02-02) was also sinus rhythm at ~77/min but with frequent premature beats and a broad, flat inverted T wave giving QT ~480 ms and QTc about 545 ms; the QTc has fallen by more than 60 ms. Rhythm and conduction are otherwise unchanged.

2021-01-18 tracing. Sinus tachycardia at 120/min, very regular (RR 0.498 s, CV 0.005), upright P in II with PR 152 ms. QRS 88 ms, no conduction block; axis +51 deg (normal). QT 276 ms, QTc 391 ms. Compared with the prior ECG of 2016-09-16 (106186980: sinus tachycardia 108/min, QTc 400 ms) the rhythm is unchanged and QTc differs by only 9 ms, so no significant interval or rhythm change.

2025-06-23 tracing. Sinus bradycardia at 54/min, regular (RR 1.10 s); upright P in II (0.12 mV) preceding every QRS but with a prolonged PR of about 214 ms - first-degree AV block. QRS 84 ms with a prominent R in V1 and very tall R in V5/V6, no bundle branch block; frontal axis about +3 deg (normal). QT 402 ms, Bazett QTc 383 ms - normal. Prior ECG (103042067, 2024-11-30): sinus bradycardia 50/min with PR ~182 ms and QTc 365 ms; rhythm unchanged, PR now longer, and QTc change is not significant.

2025-09-13 07:18 tracing. No P waves, chaotic baseline and a grossly irregular ventricular response (RR 0.29-0.58 s) at a mean rate of ~151/min - atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response; PR not measurable. QRS 94 ms, no bundle branch block; frontal axis -20 deg (normal). QT 244 ms, Bazett QTc 387 ms (mean RR). The prior ECG the previous evening (107374881, 2025-09-12) showed sinus rhythm at ~77/min with discrete P waves and PR 142 ms, so this is new atrial fibrillation (post-cardiac-surgery). QTc change (422 to 387 ms) is not significant.

2025-11-23 tracing. Sinus rhythm 73/min; prominent upright P in II (0.22 mV) with PR 170 ms. QRS 90 ms, no bundle branch block; axis +11 deg (normal). QT 365 ms, Bazett QTc 404 ms - normal. Prior ECG two days earlier (105362569, 2025-11-21) showed sinus rhythm 67/min with a much later, larger T wave: QT 506 ms, QTc 536 ms. QTc has fallen by ~132 ms, a significant decrease; rhythm and conduction are unchanged. Findings agree with the same-day note documenting sinus rhythm.

2025-02-15 tracing. Sinus rhythm 74/min, regular (RR 0.81 s); upright P in II/aVF with PR about 192 ms (upper limit of normal, no AV block). QRS 86 ms, no bundle branch block; axis +59 deg (normal). QT 383 ms, Bazett QTc 425 ms - normal. Only ECG on file, so no prior comparison.

2023-06-26 tracing. Sinus tachycardia at 111/min, almost perfectly regular (RR 0.538 s, CV 0.003); upright P in II (0.20 mV), positive in V1, PR 164 ms with 1:1 conduction - no evidence of atrial flutter despite the coded flutter history. QRS 92 ms with a very deep S in V1 and tall R in V6 (voltage criteria for LVH), no bundle branch block; axis +35 deg (normal). QT 293 ms, Bazett QTc 400 ms. Prior ECG (102955795, 2022-07-04): sinus tachycardia 114/min, PR 170 ms, QRS 92 ms, QTc 396 ms - unchanged.

2023-10-08 tracing. Sinus rhythm 68/min, P 0.17 mV upright in II, PR 130 ms, QRS 90 ms with an rS in V1 and no bundle branch block; axis +47 deg (normal). Marked repolarisation abnormality with a broad, late T wave: QT 495 ms, Bazett QTc 528 ms - prolonged. The prior ECG (100065910, 2022-11-23) had QT 323 ms / QTc 360 ms in sinus rhythm at 75/min, so QTc has increased by ~168 ms, far exceeding 60 ms. Relevant to concurrent escitalopram (see QT_SAFETY item).

2024-04-19 tracing. Sinus tachycardia at 121/min, metronomically regular (RR 0.496 s), upright P in II/aVF with PR 142 ms and stable P morphology beat to beat. QRS 74 ms, rS in V1 with dominant R in V6, no bundle branch block; axis +69 deg (normal). QT 290 ms, Bazett QTc 412 ms - normal. Only ECG on file, so no prior comparison.

2021-08-23 10:07 tracing. Sinus rhythm/mild sinus tachycardia at 101/min, upright P in II (0.16 mV), PR 138 ms, QRS 90 ms, deep S in V1 with tall R in V6 and no bundle branch block; axis +58 deg (normal). QT 323 ms, QTc 421 ms. The prior tracing was recorded 34 seconds earlier the same day (102910502: sinus 100/min, PR 138 ms, QRS 90 ms, QTc 414 ms) and is essentially identical - no rhythm, conduction or interval change.

2024-10-24 tracing. Sinus bradycardia at 52/min, regular (RR 1.16 s); low-amplitude but consistent upright P in II (0.08 mV) with PR 166 ms. QRS 92 ms with very tall R in V5/V6 (3.3 mV) and deep S in V1, suggesting left ventricular hypertrophy, but no bundle branch block; axis +37 deg (normal). QT 419 ms, Bazett QTc 389 ms - normal. Prior ECG (104629882, 2023-05-22): sinus rhythm 57/min with a single premature beat, QTc 351 ms; rhythm unchanged and QTc change (38 ms) below the 60 ms threshold.

2024-12-05 14:38 tracing. Sinus tachycardia 121/min, extremely regular, upright P in II with PR 134 ms. QRS is now narrow at 86 ms with an rS in V1 and no terminal R', i.e. normal intraventricular conduction. Frontal axis is rightward (QRS area negative in I and positive in III/aVF, ~+140 deg) = RIGHT axis deviation. QT 291 ms, QTc 414 ms - normal. The prior tracing 13 hours earlier (106516875, 2024-12-05 01:33) showed sinus rhythm with QRS 140 ms and an rsR' in V1 with terminal S in I - complete right bundle branch block - which has now resolved (intermittent RBBB). QTc 453 to 414 ms is not a significant change.

2025-11-24 tracing. Sinus rhythm 62/min, regular; small but consistent upright P in II with PR 170 ms. QRS 98 ms (no bundle branch block), tall R in V6; axis +67 deg (normal). Striking repolarisation prolongation with a very late broad T peaking ~450 ms after QRS onset: QT 549 ms, Bazett QTc 558 ms - markedly prolonged. Prior ECG (108780865, 2025-06-07): sinus bradycardia 47/min, QT 470 ms, QTc 417 ms; QTc has risen by ~141 ms since amiodarone was restarted on 2025-11-10 (see QT_SAFETY item).

2024-09-17 tracing. No discernible P waves and a grossly irregular ventricular response (RR 0.39-1.09 s, RMSSD 264 ms) at a mean rate of ~101/min - atrial fibrillation; PR is therefore not measurable. QRS 84 ms with no bundle branch block. Frontal axis about -50 deg (QRS area positive in I, negative in II, III and aVF) = left axis deviation, consistent with left anterior fascicular block. QT 320 ms, Bazett QTc 414 ms using the mean RR. No previous ECG on file.

interpretations.explanation: 2026-03-07 tracing. QRS 82 ms with no bundle branch block; frontal axis +47 deg (normal). QT 325 ms, Bazett QTc 378 ms - normal. No prior ECG on file, so no comparison possible. Findings match the same-day note documenting sinus rhythm.

2025-07-15 tracing. Sinus rhythm/mild sinus tachycardia at 104/min, regular (RR 0.578 s); clear upright P in II (0.22 mV), biphasic in V1, PR 136 ms. Note this patient's earlier 2025-02-26 tracing showed an irregular narrow-complex tachycardia consistent with atrial fibrillation.

2024-05-21 tracing. Sinus tachycardia at ~108/min, regular; upright P in II (0.12 mV) with PR about 120 ms. QRS 90 ms, no bundle branch block; axis +37 deg (normal). Repolarisation is abnormal with a low-amplitude, very broad T wave merging towards the following P: QT approximately 395 ms, Bazett QTc about 530 ms - prolonged (measurement is somewhat uncertain because of T-P fusion at this rate). No prior ECG for comparison. The patient is not on a QT watch-list medication, but the prolonged QTc merits attention.

2026-06-10 19:36 tracing. Absent P waves with a flat, undulating TQ baseline and a grossly irregular ventricular response (RR 0.35-0.65 s) at a mean rate of ~139/min - atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response; PR not measurable. QRS 98 ms, no bundle branch block; axis +2 deg (normal). QT 276 ms, Bazett QTc 420 ms (mean RR). 2024-05-23 tracing. Sinus rhythm at 97/min, regular (RR 0.616 s); upright P in II (0.18 mV) and negative in V1, PR about 118 ms. QRS 76 ms, rS in V1 with tall R in V6, no bundle branch block; axis +4 deg (normal). QT 309 ms, Bazett QTc 393 ms - normal. Only ECG on file, so no prior comparison.

2025-12-25 tracing. Sinus rhythm 72/min, regular (RR 0.83 s); small upright P in II with PR 140 ms. QRS 84 ms, deep S in V1 and dominant R in V6, no bundle branch block; axis +21 deg (normal). items.explanation: 80-year-old woman with persistent atrial fibrillation documented in serial cardiology clinic notes (most recently 2026-06-22). Guideline-recommended oral anticoagulation is absent and needs review.

Prescriber review and a repeat ECG are required.
